title: Youth justice programs: measures missed, surveys not reported, reports not filed
question: Which Justice Services programs missed a performance target, reported no survey data, or did not file a required narrative report?
finding: 3 program-years did not complete a required mid-year or year-end narrative report (Catholic Charities CYO of the Archdiocese of San Francisco, Boys Home Short-Term Residential Therapeutic Program 2024-25; Catholic Charities CYO of the Archdiocese of San Francisco, Boys Home Short-Term Residential Therapeutic Program 2025-26; Centers for Equity and Success, Inc., Credible Messengers 2025-26). 4 program-years show 'No Data' against survey targets, and 8 had no performance measures at all (the department's note: none set for that year).
how: Each program page's Performance Measure Results table was read: a survey measure is a 'Percent of surveyed participants ...' row with a target and a result; 'No Data' where the result is missing; a narrative report row reads Completed or 'Did Not Complete'.
limits: Survey results come from the department's youth survey, which some strategies were not required to give; 'No Data' can mean the survey was not given rather than ignored. A missing narrative report is a reporting lapse, not a finding about services. Pages for 21 of 33 programs were not saved.
